facts.business: Milestone Furniture Limited is an established manufacturer of office furniture and provider of comprehensive spatial, educational, and commercial interior designing solutions.
key_risks: Input Cost Volatility: Price fluctuations in raw materials (engineered wood, hardware, laminates, and metallic components) can exert pressure on operating margins.
Intense Market Competition: Competition from both unorganized local fabricators and large-scale national/international brands requires continuous product differentiation and cost optimization.
facts.related_party_note: During FY 2025-26, the Company did not enter into any contract or arrangement with related parties which was not at arm's length. During the Financial Year 2025–26, the Company has not entered into any commercial contracts or arrangements falling under Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013. Details of loan/financial transactions and closing balances with Key Managerial Personnel (Mr. Mayank Rasiklal Kotadia and Mr. Akshay Sharma) as required under the applicable Accounting Standards are disclosed in the Notes to the Audited Financial Statements.
